## Forge 1.20.1 hotfix

- Added optional Book of Dragons 1.31 compatibility.
- Salvation taming now completes Book of Dragons' native taming-ritual state instead of leaving rescued dragons classified as wild.
- Restores the native owner, follow command and minimum post-ritual affection, and clears saved hostility toward the owner.
- Previously rescued Book of Dragons entities are repaired automatically when they load again.
- Book of Dragons remains an optional dependency.

releases.notes:
# Changelog

## 1.0.1 - 2026-07-26

- Documented the complete post-taming AI model: original AI, retaliation, owner defense, two-hit assist authorization, hostile hunting, follow/stay, target lifetime, ally protection, and dismount restoration.
- Added the Entity / NBT editor page and Item Get-style creative-category item picker documentation.
- Unified direct item taming and low-health item taming into one rule with an adjustable maximum-health percentage.
- Prioritized Salvation riding over foreign entity interactions for configured owned mounts.
- Added Ice and Fire CE Cyclops compatibility so a controlled rider is not processed as a player-eating passenger and forcibly dismounted after 32 ticks.
- Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1 artifacts are built from the corresponding open-source branches.

## License

This project remains open source under GPL-3.0-only. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
